appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'. The title text claims an increasing trend.

A single blue line series is plotted. The line begins at a high vertical position on the left (2018) and ends at a lower vertical position on the right (2023), showing a downward slope across the entire period.
The line starts near the 3,500 mark in 2018, drops to approximately 3,200 in 2019, 3,100 in 2020, 2,600 in 2021, 2,300 in 2022, and ends near 1,800 in 2023.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and displays tick marks for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Production' and displays numerical ticks ranging from 0 to 3,500 in increments of 500.
Visually, the production values decrease year over year from 2018 to 2023, which contradicts the word 'Increasing' in the chart title.
